name: xyz.sofinancelab/sofinance
title: SoFinance
description: List same-stock LP pools on Raydium and Meteora, with 7-day fee APR estimates. Fees not guaranteed.

tools.name: lp_withdraw_prepare
tools.description: Prepare a fully simulated position withdrawal with a sign link. Default receive USDC; original keeps position tokens. Supply percent (1–100) OR targetUSDC. Impact above 5% requires confirmHighImpact. For two transactions, finalize the first then call again with stage=swap, tx1Signature and previous (the complete first result).

tools.name: lp_withdraw_submit
tools.description: Submit a wallet signed withdrawal. Verifies its HMAC permit and signature, checks expiry, and re-simulates before broadcast. Supply the unchanged summary and permit from lp_withdraw_prepare. If the wallet appended extra instructions (e.g. Phantom Lighthouse), also pass unsignedTransaction from lp_withdraw_prepare. High impact requires confirmHighImpact=true.

tools.name: position_get_performance
tools.description: Compute holding-period return and realized fee APR for a Raydium CLMM position NFT from finalized history and current on-chain state (not Raydium pool 24h feeApr). Prefer token-native metrics: for same-asset RWA wrap pairs (e.g. SPCXx/SPCX) report TE in the plain/base ticker using current tick mid (1.0001^tick×10^(decA−decB)), plus raw A/B inventory, holdingDays, feeOnlyAprPct and annualizedReturnPct (HPR×365/days; feesEarned/deposited×365/days). USD is optional/secondary (Jupiter Price v3 / Raydium stable-leg, labeled current — not historical). metrics.usdPerRawUnitA/B (alias metrics.priceUsdA/B, same values) and pricing.usdPerRawUnitA/B are USD per (raw / 10^decimals) token unit, ScaledUiAmount multiplier already applied; pricing.sharePriceUsdA/B is the per-share price and pricing.guard the cross-check against the pool price. Discovers open/increase/decrease txs via personal-position signatures + Anchor events + current equity. After submitting a position transaction, use refreshHistory=true and historyAfterSignatures to require its finalized history. Read-only. No token needed: wallet is optional (public on-chain data). Limited to 12 position reads per minute per IP.

wallet.description: Optional wallet to verify NFT ownership (does not change math)

maxSignatures.description: Max personal-position signatures to scan (1-500, default 100)

refreshHistory.description: Force a fresh history read after a transaction

skipPricing.description: If true, skip Jupiter/Raydium USD pricing (token-native / TE metrics still computed)

tools.name: position_get_range_status
tools.description: Compute live in-range / out-of-range status for a Raydium CLMM position from the current on-chain pool price versus tickLower/tickUpper (B per 1 A). Flags when price approaches a range edge. Read-only. No token needed: wallet is optional (public on-chain data). Limited to 12 position reads per minute per IP.

wallet.description: Optional wallet; when set it must match the Bearer token

poolId.description: Optional pool override (defaults to the position's pool)

tools.name: pools_list
tools.description: List the same-stock Solana pools on the SoFinance pools page (https://sofinancelab.xyz/pools): Raydium CLMM and Meteora DLMM pools, told apart by each pool's protocol field, where both sides are the same stock from two issuers (e.g. TSLA/TSLAx, SPCX/SPCXx), plus the USDC/USDT pool. Served from the site's saved pools snapshot, the same list the page shows. Each pool has protocol, symbols, fee tier, TVL, 24h volume, apr7d (the highest 7-day range fee APR estimate and which of the 4 range presets it comes from: Micro, Tight, Standard, Wide), and an openPositionUrl. Filter with symbol (e.g. "TSLA"). Default order: 7-day APR, high to low. estimatedFeeAprPct / estimatedFeeAprLabel are the older pool-level 24-hour figure (last 24h fees / TVL, annualized), not a 7-day estimate; small pools can show very large values, and a pool without a 7-day estimate carries a warning. Estimates from past trading, not a promise of future fees. Fees not guaranteed. For the 4 presets of one pool call pool_get_range_apr. No wallet or token needed. Opening a position through MCP (lp_open_quote / lp_open_prepare) supports Raydium CLMM only and requires a wallet token; open Meteora pools on the website.

symbol.description: Optional ticker filter, e.g. TSLA or TSLAx (case-insensitive; matches either token or the base ticker)

sortBy.description: Sort key (default apr7d, the 7-day estimate the site ranks by). estimatedFeeApr is the older pool-level 24h figure.

maxPages.description: Deprecated, ignored: the list comes from the saved snapshot.

tools.name: pool_get_range_apr
tools.description: Estimated 7-day fee APR of one listed pool (poolAddress from pools_list, Raydium or Meteora) for each of the 4 range presets the site prices: Micro (±2 price steps), Tight (±0.05%), Standard (±0.3%), Wide (±1%). Per preset: price bounds (B per 1 A), APR %, share of the last 7 days' volume that traded inside the range, and fees per day at the site's $1,000 card basis. Also the highest-APR preset, the 7-day window, data freshness and confidence. Same saved snapshot as the pool cards on https://sofinancelab.xyz/pools. New pools (too few days of data) and missing snapshots return a status with a reason and no APR. Estimates from past trading, not a promise of future fees. Fees not guaranteed. No wallet or token needed.

tools.name: positions_list
tools.description: List all Raydium CLMM positions and wallet assets. Returns position NFTs (with pool, ticks, liquidity) and eligible input assets (SOL, tokens) with balances. Read-only, no private keys required. Use this first to discover available positions and assets. No token needed: pass any wallet address (public on-chain data). Limited to 12 position reads per minute per IP.

tools.name: lp_add_quote
tools.description: Get a quote for adding liquidity to a position. Estimates swap routes (Jupiter), price impact, output amounts, and immediate resale gap. Verifies NFT ownership, pool state, and balance. Read-only. Quotes expire quickly (configured TTL). Failure modes: insufficient balance, high price impact (>5%), resale floor breach, quote expiration, pool state changes.

inputMint.description: Input asset mint address (from positions_list assets)

inputKind.description: Asset kind: 'native' for SOL, 'token' for SPL tokens

amount.description: Amount in token units (e.g. '1.5' for 1.5 SOL)

resaleFloorBps.description: Minimum resale ratio in basis points (9500-10000, default 9900 = 1% max loss). Conservative immediate-resale protection.

slippageToleranceBps.description: Add-liquidity price tolerance in basis points (0-500, multiple of 10, default 100 = 1%). Liquidity is sized so the pool price may drift this much before execution; the unused reserve stays in the wallet. Jupiter swap slippage stays fixed at 0.5%.

tools.name: lp_add_prepare
tools.description: Prepare an unsigned, fully-simulated transaction for adding liquidity. Returns base64-encoded transaction for signing, HMAC permit, and summary. The server NEVER holds private keys. Transaction must be signed by the user/agent wallet. Includes: full simulation, 1232-byte limit check, Jupiter swap + Raydium increase_liquidity_v2, short-lived permit. Failure modes: same as lp_add_quote, plus simulation failure, size limit, blockhash expiry. After signing, use lp_add_submit.

resaleFloorBps.description: Resale floor in basis points (9500-10000, default 9900)

slippageToleranceBps.description: Add-liquidity price tolerance in basis points (0-500, multiple of 10, default 100)

tools.name: lp_compound_quote
tools.description: Get a quote for compounding a position (harvest fees/rewards, swap to ratio, reinvest). Returns expected liquidity increase, swap plan, simulation results. Verifies position eligibility. Read-only. Phase one: rejects third reward tokens (no verifiable swap path). Failure modes: ineligible position, third reward token, insufficient harvested fees for minimum liquidity unit, swap plan failure.

sourceSignatures.description: Optional: prior harvest transaction signatures to merge (max 3)

tools.name: lp_compound_prepare
tools.description: Prepare an unsigned compound transaction. Returns base64 transaction, permit, and summary. Same safety as lp_add_prepare: full simulation, HMAC permit, no private keys. After signing, use lp_compound_submit.

tools.name: lp_add_submit
tools.description: Submit a signed add-liquidity transaction. Re-verifies HMAC permit, re-reads on-chain state, re-simulates, then broadcasts. Pass signedTransaction plus every field of submitArgs from the lp_add_prepare response, unchanged. Failure modes: permit mismatch, state changed (liquidity, balance, NFT), expired (time or blockhash), simulation failure. Returns transaction signature on success.

unsignedTransaction.description: Base64 prepared transaction from lp_add_prepare. Pass this when the wallet rewrote the message (Phantom Lighthouse / ComputeBudget).

tools.name: lp_compound_submit
tools.description: Submit a signed compound transaction. Re-verifies permit and summary, then broadcasts. Returns signature on success. Same safety as lp_add_submit.

unsignedTransaction.description: Base64 prepared transaction from lp_compound_prepare. Pass this when the wallet rewrote the message (Phantom Lighthouse / ComputeBudget).

summary.description: Complete summary object from lp_compound_prepare response, unchanged (bound by the permit)

tools.name: lp_open_quote
tools.description: Quote opening a NEW Raydium CLMM position in a pool (no existing NFT). Input SOL/USDC/pool token, amount, and a price range (presets tight ±0.05% / standard ±0.3% / wide ±1%, or custom minPrice/maxPrice in B per 1 A). Returns expected A/B after Jupiter swap-to-ratio, tick-aligned range, in/out-of-range, price impact, refundable vs non-refundable SOL rent (NFT + tick arrays), and Token-2022/freeze flags. Fails clearly on insufficient balance, >5% impact, transfer-fee/freeze, or unfunded tick arrays the wallet cannot pay. Read-only.

inputMint.description: "SOL" or "USDC" (resolved to So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112 / EPjFWdd5AufqSSqeM2qN1xzybapC8G4wEGGkZwyTDt1v), or a mint address in the pool

rangePreset.description: Default standard (±0.3% around current B-per-A price)

minPrice.description: Custom range min price (B per 1 A), required if rangePreset=custom

maxPrice.description: Custom range max price (B per 1 A), required if rangePreset=custom

resaleFloorBps.description: Minimum resale ratio in basis points (9500-10000, default 9900)

slippageToleranceBps.description: Open-position price tolerance in basis points (0-500, default 100). Jupiter swap slippage stays 0.5%.

tools.name: lp_open_prepare
tools.description: Prepare an unsigned, fully-simulated transaction that opens a new CLMM position. Prefer passing nftMint from an agent-held Keypair so the server never signs: wallet signs first, then add the mint signature on the wallet-returned tx and call lp_open_submit. Without nftMint, open signUrl: the sign page generates the mint in the browser, re-prepares, wallet signs first, then the mint (the returned tx is a preview only). HMAC permit, summary, signUrl. 1232-byte limit, fresh blockhash, full simulation. Not lp_add_submit — this tx has two required signers.

nftMint.description: Client-generated position NFT mint public key. Prefer this so the server never signs. Omit only for the MCP signUrl fallback.

tools.name: lp_open_submit
tools.description: Submit a signed open-position transaction. Re-verifies HMAC permit, re-reads pool/balances, re-simulates (sigVerify true, including the NFT-mint partial signature), then broadcasts. Pass signedTransaction plus permit, wallet, and the complete summary from lp_open_prepare, unchanged. If the wallet rewrote the message (Phantom Lighthouse / ComputeBudget), also pass unsignedTransaction from prepare. Returns signature and the new positionMint.

unsignedTransaction.description: Base64 prepared transaction from lp_open_prepare. Pass this when the wallet rewrote the message (Phantom Lighthouse / ComputeBudget).

summary.description: Complete summary object from lp_open_prepare, unchanged (bound by the permit)

tools.name: tx_status
tools.description: Finality of one Solana transaction signature. No token needed. Use it after a wallet that broadcasts by itself (e.g. Phantom MCP solana_send) sends a transaction prepared here, instead of a submit_* tool. status: finalized | confirmed | failed (landed, but failed on-chain) | pending (ask again in a few seconds) | expired (never landed and its blockhash expired: safe to prepare again) | unknown (not seen yet and no lastValidBlockHeight given). One status lookup per call; poll no faster than every 2 seconds. Read-only.

signature.description: Base58 transaction signature (64 bytes) returned by the wallet

lastValidBlockHeight.description: lastValidBlockHeight from the prepare result (summary). With it, a signature Solana never saw is reported as pending until the blockhash expires, then expired.

commitment.description: confirmed (default) reports a landed transaction as soon as the cluster confirms it; finalized waits for finalization.
